verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs say its API can create incidents automatically from CI/CD pipelines and other external automation systems. Non-interactive access uses generated, role-scoped API keys, and an OpenAPI spec and versioned API changelog support scripted, headless use. The MCP server adds another programmatic, non-UI way in. Missing for 10: a documented first-party CLI or CI integration (e.g., a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
